dog.description_text: Meet Cider, the sweetest little shadow you’ll ever have and the perfect companion to ADOPT this fall! He is an adorable 11 week old Lab mix weighing just 15 lbs, with big puppy paws he’s still growing into and an even BIGGER heart! Cider is a professional cuddler, part time lap dog, and full time best friend in training. He loves his toys, is a quick learner, and has already mastered his puppy pads! He loves playtime, a few treats, and then using your lap as a pillow for a nap. Cider is counting down the days until he finishes his vaccines and can explore the big world outside on those adorable paws!
dog.name: Cider
